chunks: "Whoever wishes for his wealth to increase should prolong the standing at al-Safa and al-Marwah."

key_terms.الصَّفَا: al-Safa, one of the two well-known places of sa'y
key_terms.الْمَرْوَةِ: al-Marwah, the other of the two well-known places of sa'y

ai.seo_question: What should a person do at al-Safa and al-Marwah if they wish for their wealth to increase?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages prolonging one's standing at al-Safa and al-Marwah during hajj as a means connected to increase in wealth. It highlights a spiritual act of worship that is linked with worldly blessing.
